name: Choco Almond N' Kesar Badam Double Sundae
ingredients_raw: Kesar Badam Magic (50%) - Milk solids, sugar, kesar elaichi ripple (water, sugar, dextrose, permitted stabilizer (E440), almond pieces (2%), permitted emulsifier (E471) and stabilizers (E407, E466, E415, E412, E435). Choco Almond (50%) – Milk solids, sugar, chocolate ripple (water, sugar, dextrose, cocoa solids, permitted stabilizer (E440)), cocoa solids, almond pieces (2%), permitted emulsifier (E471) and stabilizers E407, E466, E415, E412). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS (E102, E110) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CARDAMOM AND SAFFRON)
